title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
abstract: arXiv:2611.31133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. translated_title: 连载与人物系统：测量法国小说（1800—1940）中的叙事集中度
translated_abstract: 每部小说都在其人物之间分配有限的叙事注意力，而这种分配的形态——是围绕单一人物组织叙事，还是分散于众多人物——是否有一段历史，远不像关于主人公的大量批评评论所暗示的那样已成定论。我们将Woloch提出的“人物系统”概念，即由“一”与“多”之间的张力所结构化的小说人物群体间叙事注意力分配，操作化为人物网络中PageRank分布的不平等性（基尼系数）。我们基于Gallica小说的"Hors d'usage"语料库，在1800年至1940年间出版的12,011部法国小说中追踪这一结构集中度指标。在整个漫长的十九世纪中，该轨迹呈U形：集中度在1850至1860年代降至低谷，随后在世纪之交再次上升。这一变化的幅度较小，与……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将Woloch的“人物系统”理论操作化为人物网络PageRank分布的基尼系数，通过分析1800至1940年间的12,011部法国小说，首次量化揭示了叙事集中度随时间呈U形演变的历史轨迹。
en_tdlr: This study operationalizes Woloch's character-system concept as the Gini coefficient of the PageRank distribution over character networks, and by analyzing 12,011 French novels (1800–1940), quantitatively reveals a U-shaped historical trajectory of narrative concentration.
